title: CRAFT: Conflict-Resolved Aggregation for Federated Training
abstract: arXiv:2605.21317v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The aggregation of conflicting client updates remains a fundamental bottleneck in federated learning (FL) under heterogeneous data distributions. Naive averaging can produce a global update that improves the global objective while conflicting with specific clients, causing degradation for those clients. In this work, we propose CRAFT (Conflict-Resolved Aggregation for Federated Training), a new aggregation framework that treats the global update as a geometric correction problem. We formulate aggregation as finding the update closest to a reference direction while satisfying conflict-free alignment constraints. We derive a closed-form expression for the constrained optimization problem, avoiding the computational overhead of iterative solvers. translated_title: CRAFT：面向联邦训练的冲突消解聚合
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.21317v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：在异构数据分布下，相互冲突的客户端更新的聚合仍然是联邦学习（FL）中的一个根本性瓶颈。朴素平均可能产生一个虽然改善了全局目标、却与特定客户端相冲突的全局更新，从而导致这些客户端的性能下降。在本工作中，我们提出了CRAFT（面向联邦训练的冲突消解聚合），这是一种新的聚合框架，它将全局更新视为一个几何校正问题。我们将聚合形式化为：在满足无冲突对齐约束的条件下，寻找最接近参考方向的更新。我们为该约束优化问题推导出了闭式解表达式，避免了迭代求解器带来的计算开销。此外，我们采用逐层自适应机制来处理不同特征粒度上的冲突。我们提供了理论分析，表明CRAFT能够促进一种共同下降结构……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出CRAFT聚合框架，将联邦学习中冲突客户端更新的聚合建模为带无冲突对齐约束的几何校正问题，利用闭式解避免迭代求解开销，并通过逐层自适应处理不同粒度的冲突，从而缓解特定客户端的性能退化。
en_tdlr: CRAFT is a new federated learning aggregation framework that formulates the aggregation of conflicting client updates as a geometric correction problem with conflict-free alignment constraints, deriving a closed-form solution with layer-wise adaptation to avoid iterative solver overhead and prevent performance degradation for individual clients.
